evidence: Workbook quality/internal row 16 asks that the agent receive inputs and the ask without a finished deliverable. Frozen task/environment/Dockerfile:14-23 copies only instructions/ and assets/, then initializes /app with .gitkeep; the Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template. The entire environment tree has only that Dockerfile, two prose notes and seed_data.json. The notes contain business rules and runtime requirements, no executable starter, database DDL, app route list or UI. hireops_rules.md:54-56 expressly leaves routes, field names and page shape to the builder. The seed is raw business records/constants, not a ready application. All 108 criterion IDs were checked against the notes with no matches; the longest exact whitespace-token sequence shared by a criterion description and a note is six ordinary business words. Measured agent-build.log:35-43,54-57,65 records the two COPY steps, an empty Git repository, one zero-line .gitkeep commit and image sha256:6f870f89caf1f289e70732cbc1d5a430722288d7902f0dc56f58728da69b0e84. input-binding.json images.agent binds that same image and its three copied files to the frozen source bytes; all relevant source and artifact hashes were independently recalculated. Verified artifact SHA256: agent-build.log=32a042b0b6cfe263fe568bca4c62734a7c31ea6d4b3ce104a7151de2232745c9; input-binding.json=b0d475a9cf64ed2e01b6a01999e8baa1302e27f6f74b9b95faf00d5490312fbb; bind-inputs.py=5a8ccedbd9e006efa7dcf34759bb4bd329241db7974d67f977a6464dc7b32451. Adversarial consideration: a seed-only dashboard cannot obtain a finished implementation or hidden rubric by copying any task-supplied agent asset. A conforming app with different routes/schema/page layout remains possible; public formulas and input record shapes are legitimate requirements, and the canonical health endpoint is not a leaked implementation route list. This conclusion concerns the environment boundary only; no configured judge score, complete filesystem enumeration or portal result is claimed.
